WhoIAm.title: Who I Am
WhoIAm.p1: Hello and welcome to my portfolio. My name is Arnaud, and I’m a UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer based in Val-de-Marne, near Paris.
WhoIAm.p2: For over 15 years, I’ve been putting my expertise to work for e-commerce projects, managing their development, evolution and integration while ensuring an optimal user experience through thoughtful, effective design. Along the way, I’ve built a strong background in art direction, backed by solid expertise in project management.
WhoIAm.p3: Always keeping an eye on what’s new and making the most of today’s tools and methodologies, I deliver high-performing, future-proof solutions, designed around the user.
WhoIAm.p4: And when I’m not in Figma or VS Code, I’m probably out running, hiking in the woods, dancing awkwardly, or saving the kingdom in a tabletop role-playing campaign.

WhatIDo.title: What I Do
WhatIDo.intro: I design and build interfaces, from the first wireframe to production. Fifteen years of e-commerce taught me what makes a journey simple, fast and effective: that’s what I bring to every project.

uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: Clear, accessible interfaces designed around your users, validated through prototyping and testing.
uiux.details: Every journey is designed to simplify navigation and strengthen accessibility (WCAG). I rely on proven UX methods, from user research to wireframes, interactive prototypes, design systems and testing, all the way to a developer-ready interface.

artDirection.title: Art Direction
artDirection.description: A strong, consistent visual identity, rolled out across every medium, from print to digital.
artDirection.details: I imagine identities tailored to each brand’s values and world: graphic line, brand guidelines and communication strategy. I then lead the creation of visual content, for a clear, consistent creative direction aligned with your goals.

media.title: Media Creation
media.description: Banners, videos, emails, social media: content that grabs attention and stays true to your brand.
media.details: I produce communication assets for every channel: banners, videos, motion design, email kits, social media visuals and print-ready files. Each piece strengthens the brand image and supports your marketing goals.

frontEnd.title: Front‑End Development
frontEnd.description: Designs faithfully built in React and Next.js: fast, responsive and easy to evolve.
frontEnd.details: I build high-performing, accessible interfaces with modular, maintainable code that follows modern front-end best practices: React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. SaaS applications, headless sites or PWAs: smooth experiences on every screen.

projectManagement.title: Project Management
projectManagement.description: From strategy to delivery, I bridge design, development and business so the project keeps moving.
projectManagement.details: My dual background in design and development eases coordination between teams and keeps the project consistent, from strategy to launch. I organize the work the agile way, with user experience as the common thread.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce
ecommerce.description: Shopping journeys that convert: structured catalogs, streamlined checkouts and fast sites.
ecommerce.details: I work on complex e‑commerce platforms: catalog structure, PIM/ERP integrations and business data flows, customer journeys, performance and technical SEO. The goal: a site that’s pleasant to browse, and that sells.

cloudcastle.description: Co-founded CloudCastle in 2024 to build Questix, an AI-powered TTRPG campaign manager. Designed the front-end (Next.js 13) and UX for a web app that helps DMs and players streamline scheduling, prep, and lore with smart tools, CI/CD pipelines, and seamless offline/online play.

heroui.description: Supported the development of HeroUI, a component library inspired by Material Design. Worked on cross-framework portability, debugging complex UI behaviors, and aligning accessibility with EU compliance standards.

contentsquare.description: Completed training on ContentSquare’s digital experience analytics platform. Learned to analyze user behavior with tools like heatmaps, session replays, and zoning analysis to optimize UX and conversion.

majitv.description: Designed a custom pixel-art visual identity and provided branding and layout guidance to support the launch and growth of a new Twitch channel.

googleAnalytics.description: Earned Google Analytics 4 certification. Gained proficiency in tracking user behavior, setting up events, and leveraging data insights to optimize digital experiences.

foundry.description: Collaborated on the development of several community-driven JavaScript modules and plugins, helping expand Foundry VTT’s ecosystem and enhancing the platform’s extensibility and user experience.

leclerc.description: Handling a broad range of digital initiatives across the E.Leclerc ecosystem, from UI/UX design and front-end development (React, Next.js) to modular e-commerce components, emailing, and user testing. Notably involved in the redesign of Voyages E.Leclerc, while also contributing to cross-functional projects impacting other platforms and teams. Focused on building scalable interfaces, optimizing user flows, and improving overall digital performance in collaboration with marketing, product, and tech stakeholders.

freelance.description: As a freelance web designer, I delivered a wide array of digital services tailored to diverse client needs. My projects ranged from photo retouching for e-commerce platforms like La Plateforme du Bâtiment, crafting engaging email campaigns for DogFidelity, to website design for professional photographers, and developing brand identities for non-profit organizations like Vocajob. My role involved direct client interaction to capture vision and requirements, implementing design solutions that enhance user engagement and visually communicate each brand’s unique value proposition effectively.

delaveine.description: Managed and enhanced the online presence of Delaveine, a men’s fashion retailer. Responsibilities included website maintenance and development, creating eye-catching ads and banners for promotions, photo retouching, and assembly for online product displays. Also handled the integration of email newsletters, ensuring consistent and effective communication with customers.

itecomDev.description: Received specialized training as a Front-End Developer and Integrator at Itecom Art Design, honing skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web design. Focused on optimizing website ergonomics, enhancing cross-device compatibility, and improving search engine optimization (SEO). Projects involved hands-on practice with coding, layout adjustments, and integrating user-centered design principles to boost site performance and accessibility.

itecomPm.description: Completed a comprehensive training program focusing on web design and project management. Developed expertise in building engaging websites, capturing user interest through innovative design and intuitive navigation. Skilled in identifying project requirements and analyzing user needs to deliver tailored digital solutions. Enhanced proficiency in managing end-to-end project lifecycles, ensuring seamless execution and optimum user engagement.

itecomGraphic.description: Studied visual identity and graphic design at Itecom Art Design, focusing on mastering essential skills in page layout and visual composition. Gained proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, learning to create cohesive design models that effectively communicate across various media. Engaged in practical projects that emphasized both the creative and technical aspects of design.
